lines.text: I'm on my last legs after this hike.

data.define: Used when you are almost out of energy.

example.ctx: At the end of a hike
example.text: I'm on my last legs after this hike.

misuse.text: Don't say 'on my last legs' about a chair.

publish.title: What does "on my last legs" mean?
publish.value: On my last legs = Extremely tired. Example: "I'm on my last legs after this hike." (casual English).
